name: Abjurer

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A protective mage whose Arcane Ward soaks damage and whose counters shut down enemy spells.

feature.name: Abjuration Savant
feature.summary: Add two Abjuration spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free.
feature.text: Choose two Wizard spells from the Abjuration school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one more Abjuration Wizard spell of a level you can cast for free.

feature.name: Arcane Ward
feature.summary: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot raises a ward with 2 × Wizard level + Int modifier HP that absorbs damage.
feature.text: When you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, you can create a magical ward on yourself that lasts until your next Long Rest. It has a Hit Point maximum of twice your Wizard level + your Intelligence modifier; damage you take hits the ward first. Casting further Abjuration spells with slots restores twice the slot's level to it, and as a Bonus Action you can spend a slot to restore twice its level.

feature.name: Projected Ward
feature.summary: Reaction: your Arcane Ward absorbs damage dealt to a creature within 30 feet.
feature.text: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can take a Reaction to let your Arcane Ward soak that damage instead. If the damage drops the ward to 0 Hit Points, the protected creature takes whatever is left.

feature.name: Spell Breaker
feature.summary: Counterspell and Dispel Magic always prepared; add Proficiency Bonus to dispel checks.
feature.text: You always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared. You can cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action and add your Proficiency Bonus to its ability check. When you cast either spell with a spell slot and it fails to stop a spell, the slot isn't expended.

feature.name: Spell Resistance
feature.summary: Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to their damage.
